[[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] '''Jarix''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who was a crony of the corrupt [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Virk]] in [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. He was with Virk when he tried to bully a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|member]] of [[Havoc Squad]] for trying to expose Virk's corruption. Virk ordered him to attack, but he refused to go up against a member of Havoc Squad.
